Accompanying Vietlook Travel to conquer the top hottest tourist destinations in Nha Trang that always captivate people, experiencing luxury resorts and enjoying delicious and attractive dishes, and freely checking in for yourself beautiful pictures on the beach of Nha Trang island is one of the fun vacations that Vietlook wants to accompany you.

1. About Nha Trang – Vietnam

Nha Trang is located in the East of Khanh Hoa province, 1,290km north of Hanoi, 45km from Cam Ranh city and 441km south of Ho Chi Minh city.

The East of the city borders the East Sea and has many beautiful beaches that are destinations chosen by many tourists. You can choose to travel Nha Trang and Khanh Hoa by any means such as: plane, train, bus, private car…

Nha Trang is located in the South Central Coast region of Vietnam. Therefore, Nha Trang city has a tropical monsoon climate, so the climate here is relatively mild with temperatures ranging from 26-27°C, so Nha Trang is a year-round destination.

2. Where to stay when traveling to Nha Trang?

Nha Trang has many 5-star hotels located in prime locations, with many different prices. In the summer, the beachfront hotels and Nha Trang island resorts are often fully booked early, while smaller hotels located in the city center are often cheaper and have more available rooms, making it convenient for those traveling to Nha Trang on their own.

Some high-quality hotels in Nha Trang city include: Queen Ann, TTC Hotel Premium, Eastin Grand, Ariyana Smart Condotel and Muong Thanh Luxury. For those who like to relax, you can choose Champa Island Resort, Amiana Resort, Diamond Bay Resort Spa or Merperle Hon Tam island resorts and Vinpearl Nha Trang.

3. Nha Trang tourist attractions

Hon Mun Island

As one of the most beautiful islands in Nha Trang Bay, Hon Mun is a destination chosen by many tourists, especially those traveling to Nha Trang in the summer. Hon Mun is located about 10km from Cau Da port and it takes about 20 minutes by canoe to get to the island for tourists to admire the vast scenery.

The highlight of Hon Mun is the prominent black rocks, clear blue sea water and beautiful natural scenery. When coming here, visitors can walk on the rocks and take memorable photos during their trip.

Hon Mun has a total area of ​​up to 160 km2, including 122 km2 of sea surface and 38 km2 of total island area, has a marine reserve with many rare marine species such as fish, coral, and is a place where swallows fly back to nest in black rock caves.

The wonderful thing about Hon Mun – Nha Trang is the convergence of two hot and cold ocean currents. One current flows down from the North and one flows up from the Equator. Therefore, marine species like to migrate here to live and reproduce, especially tropical corals and marine species.

Hon Mun has the highest coral yield in Vietnam and is ranked by WWF as the most diverse marine life area in Vietnam.

Coral Bay

Famous for its clear blue water, and home to many underwater activities such as: Scuba diving, sea walking and glass-bottom boat tours, visitors can admire the sparkling coral reefs, the ideal time to visit Nha Trang Coral Bay is from January to August. The peak season is from June to August, which is also the busiest time of year for Nha Trang tourism.

If you like to experience scuba diving to see Nha Trang coral, you should go to Coral Bay to experience it with a cost of 450,000 VND/dive, each dive usually lasts 30 minutes, you will dive with a professional guide. So you can rest assured to participate in the scuba diving service at Coral Bay.

Bai Tranh

About 500m long, surrounded by majestic mountains and forests. On one side is a fine white sand beach, on the other side are beautiful natural rocks, giving this place its own beauty, different from other scenic areas in Nha Trang, and is a destination chosen by many tourists.

Below is a clear blue beach, long stretches of white sand, surrounded by rows of cool green trees creating a beautiful picture that is both wild and poetic.

Tri Nguyen Aquarium

Tri Nguyen Aquarium, also known as Tri Nguyen Fish Pond, is located on Hon Mieu Island in the Nha Trang Bay archipelago, about 2km from Nha Trang Port. The aquarium is designed in the shape of a giant ship covered with moss, with mysterious stones and is a check-in point chosen by many tourists, especially young people who often visit this scenic area when coming to Nha Trang.

Nha Trang Aquarium is designed like a giant ship floating on the sea. Inside the ship there are many floors. The first floor is a fish pond, the second floor is a souvenir shop and the third floor is a restaurant.

The fish pond floor is located near sea level and is decorated in a cave style with many types of rocks, including four large fish tanks and some small tanks. Many marine creatures are displayed in their natural environment.

There are special fish species here where visitors can find small fish such as seahorses, a unique fish species with males carrying eggs and giving birth. Other rare fish species include Japanese carp, Napoleon fish, Picasso fish…

Nha Phu Bay

Nha Phu Bay, also known as Nha Phu Lagoon, is located about 15km north of Nha Trang city center. The tourist port is currently located in Luong Son commune, Vinh Luong, Nha Trang city. Nha Phu Bay is famous for its diverse terrain, including small islands, streams, seas, lakes, mountains and bays.

If you have the opportunity to go on a tour of Nha Trang, visit Nha Phu Bay to feel the natural beauty with long white sand beaches and diverse flora. In addition, there are many rare species of plants here.

Binh Ba Island

Nam in Cam Ranh is known as Lobster Island, one of the most beautiful tourist destinations that nature has bestowed on Nha Trang – Khanh Hoa. Binh Ba has many pristine beaches but still exudes a captivating charm, along with a rich and delicious seafood cuisine system that promises to bring unique and unforgettable experiences to visitors.

Binh Ba Island is quite far from the center, there are no restaurants or hotels like in the city. There are only homestays run by local people. However, you will experience the daily life of a fishing village with island fishermen.

Robinson Island

Located 20km from the mainland, Robinson Island Nha Trang is a small island in Cam Ranh Bay, Khanh Hoa Province. Robinson looks like a small valley in the middle of the ocean, where the climate is cool and peaceful with a 100km long white sand beach and clear blue sea water. Coming here, you will enjoy diving in the clear water or relax and enjoy the beautiful scenery with a cool glass of coconut water, giving visitors the most enjoyable vacation.

Diep Son Island

One of the most pristine and romantic islands in Nha Trang is a place blessed by nature with a natural and pristine beauty. From afar, Diep Son Island looks like a green silk strip with small islands gathered together, creating a colorful picture.

The special thing that attracts tourists to Diep Son Island is the unique sea walking path. This path is like a white silk strip separating the two islands. When walking on the path, visitors will feel like they are walking on the sea. Surrounded by the vast ocean, calm and gentle, it promises to be an extremely interesting experience that this place brings to visitors.

Hon Tre Island

Coming here, you will encounter a more bustling scene than other islands. Here, visitors also visit two large villages, Bich Dam and Vung Anh.

Hon Tre Island in Nha Trang has a small, beautiful and pristine beach, diverse and rich natural vegetation. If you look from above, you will see the beauty that nature has bestowed upon this place.

In addition, when you come to the island, you can also participate in many famous entertainment activities, resorts, and spas in Nha Trang. Especially when you come to Vinpearl Land, you can participate, besides that, there is also the Con Se Tre scenic area, which is a popular destination for many tourists.

Yen Island – Hon Noi

This is a cluster of islands, about 25km from Cau Da port, equivalent to 13 nautical miles, quite far, so if you go by boat, it will take you about 1 hour and 20 minutes to get to the island, but if you go by canoe, you can shorten the time for you to visit a lot.

Yen Island – Hon Noi is the habitat and living place of many species of swallows that nest and live on the island, every afternoon the birds fly in the sky, looking like a beautiful multi-colored picture that nature has bestowed on Nha Trang.

4. What to eat when traveling to Nha Trang?

Bird’s Nest: Nha Trang is one of the specialties that Nha Trang brings to tourists, tourists can not only enjoy but also bring back as gifts.

Sea ribs, Nha Trang lobster are attractive dishes chosen by many gourmet tourists when coming to Nha Trang, in addition, tourists also enjoy popular dishes such as snails, boho fish…

Jellyfish noodles are one of the freshest seafood in Nha Trang, jellyfish noodles with a cool taste, the dish chosen by most tourists in the summer.

Squid with tamarind sauce: A dish chosen by many tourists, a famous specialty of the Nha Trang island region.

Ninh Hoa sour sausage, tourists not only enjoy but also bring back as gifts when coming to Nha Trang.

5. Notes when visiting Nha Trang Island

Transportation: You can choose means of transportation in Nha Trang such as: Motorbike, taxi, canoe…, and you should find out in advance, especially means of transportation that require tickets and have schedules such as canoes, to avoid inconvenience during your tour.

Because of the hot summer weather, when going to Nha Trang Island, you should prepare sun protection items such as long-sleeved shirts, sunglasses, hats, sunscreen…

When visiting the islands in Nha Trang, you need to prepare personal documents, and find out which islands to visit, means of transportation, ticket prices to the islands in Nha Trang,…

You can also learn about local specialties to buy as gifts, and don’t forget to survey the prices before buying to avoid being charged too high.

Vietlook Travel hopes that through this article, we will share with you the most useful information about Nha Trang Island, Vietnam for your upcoming trip. Under the gentle sunlight, the shyness of Nha Trang beach appears like a watercolor painting with its own unique features.

Discover the sea and islands of Nha Trang – Vietnam, this is also an attractive destination for tourists to visit. It can be said that when you come here, you can not only immerse yourself in the cool sea water but also enjoy endless entertainment, delicious and attractive dishes, and when you return, you will not forget to make a date to return. Especially for foreign tourists when going on a tour Vietnam, they all visit and admire the beauty of Nha Trang.
